whiteboards.words: Here's the funnel. At the top, every new coin, the second it gets listed or shows up on a decentralized exchange, the bots flag the one with unusual activity. Then it scans everything about it. Who funded it? Who's backing it? Where is it listed? How big is it? Who's holding it? Et cetera, et cetera, et cetera. What comes out at the bottom is a handful of plays.
whiteboards.scene: Blank paper. A wide funnel draws top to bottom: mouth, narrowing tiers, spout. A stream of small coins pours into the mouth under the label NEW COINS, with two small tags, aggregator listings and new DEX pairs. Three little bot heads on the rim light up and flag a few coins, label BOTS FLAG ACTIVITY; the unflagged coins fade. Sieves draw across the tiers and take their labels one per question: FUNDING and BACKERS on the first, EXCHANGE LISTINGS, MARKET CAP, then a small plain tag HOLDERS; fewer coins pass each sieve; three dots mark the et ceteras. Payoff: three or four coins drop out of the spout into a small tray and the label A HANDFUL OF PLAYS writes on. No count on any stage. It ends on the finished drawing.
